purpose: Disposition every non-bullet roadmap clause so numbered/prose/code obligations cannot escape the canonical RNX promise universe.

global_clauses.text: Before implementation, the new chat must merge it with current source reality and all historical obligations, then assign exact promise numbers and exact overlay/full-plan counts. Do not assume these labels are final merely because they are written here.

supplemental_clauses.text: Establish one canonical runtime/config/lifecycle authority and remove hard architectural dependence on `/data/adb/modules/rclone` in managed mode.
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Umbrella goal; direct position-1 bullets enumerate the concrete authority/adoption obligations.

supplemental_clauses.text: Trace and converge at least:
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Introduces the directly-numbered production-ingress bullets that follow.

supplemental_clauses.text: Make rclone-compatible binaries first-class immutable candidates rather than package-fixed dependencies.
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Umbrella goal represented by import-source, manifest and qualification promises.

supplemental_clauses.text:
/data/adb/rclone-nexus/runtimes/<runtime-id>/
├── rclone
└── manifest.json
supplemental_clauses.rationale: The roadmap explicitly labels this layout Suggested; canonical paths are governed by the numbered runtime-root/store promises.

supplemental_clauses.text: At minimum:
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Introduces the directly-numbered manifest/provenance bullets.

supplemental_clauses.text: Every candidate must be tested equivalently regardless of brand/source:
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Cross-source equality is the combination of all canonical source forms and the shared qualifier boundary.

supplemental_clauses.text: Switch runtime engines safely without reinstalling Nexus.
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Umbrella activation/rollback goal represented by position-3 requirements.

supplemental_clauses.text:
QUALIFIED
 -> STAGED
 -> QUIESCING
 -> ACTIVE_PENDING_VERIFY
 -> ACTIVE
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Success-state sequence is represented by durable identity, quiesce, reverify, restart, stable-retention, staged reboot and crash-recovery promises.

supplemental_clauses.text: Failure path:
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Introduces the mapped rollback state-machine block.

supplemental_clauses.text:
ACTIVE_PENDING_VERIFY
 -> ROLLBACK
 -> previous runtime
 -> RECOVERED / DEGRADED_RECOVERED
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Rollback/recovery sequence is represented by rollback, retention, recovery-window and degraded-recovery promises.

supplemental_clauses.text:
racctl runtime list
racctl runtime inspect <id>
racctl runtime test <id>
racctl runtime activate <id>
racctl runtime rollback
supplemental_clauses.rationale: The roadmap explicitly calls these commands envisioned; production CLI adoption is separately numbered.

supplemental_clauses.text: Adversarially prove X01-X03 against production entry points.
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Umbrella gate purpose represented by all position-4 gate bullets.

supplemental_clauses.text: Audit loop repeats until no adoption gap.
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Gate-audit-loop behavior is governed by GOVERNING_CAMPAIGN_PROTOCOL rule 22 rather than a product promise.

supplemental_clauses.text: Make source selection convenient and deterministic.
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Umbrella source-selection goal including the two previously unnumbered deterministic-resolution invariants.

supplemental_clauses.text: The implementation must dynamically resolve latest stable bclone at check time. Never hardcode `v1.75.3`; that was merely the current release discussed.
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Distinct positive invariant not fully represented by the original source bullets.

supplemental_clauses.text: Resolve mutable refs (`latest`, tag) to immutable commit/assets before qualification and persist the resolution.
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Distinct positive immutable-resolution/persistence invariant.

supplemental_clauses.text: Build latest bclone/rclone as Android arm64 when release assets are unsuitable.
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Umbrella SOURCE-X02 goal represented by direct build/output/integration promises.

supplemental_clauses.text: Prefer a reproducible CI builder (e.g. GitHub Actions) using Android NDK because user’s primary Termux host is arm64 and official NDK host tools are commonly x86_64-oriented.
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Preference/rationale rather than a mandatory product invariant; concrete build/toolchain obligations are numbered.

supplemental_clauses.text: Detect, qualify and stage updates without blindly altering a rooted device.
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Umbrella update goal represented by policy and safety promises.

supplemental_clauses.text: Suggested knobs:
supplemental_clauses.rationale: The roadmap explicitly marks these knobs suggested; recommended defaults and required update behavior are numbered separately.

supplemental_clauses.text:
check automatically
resolve latest
build/download automatically
qualify automatically
stage passing candidate automatically
activate automatically (optional)
restart active mounts automatically (optional)
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Suggested configuration surface; exact recommended defaults are direct canonical bullets.

supplemental_clauses.text: Recommended default for personal use:
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Introduces the directly-numbered recommended-default bullets.

supplemental_clauses.text: Simulated GitHub/provider labels are not enough for final qualification.
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Real source/download/qualification/activation ingress obligations jointly prohibit label-only qualification.

supplemental_clauses.text: Move existing installations to Nexus-managed standalone state without losing configuration or leaving competing authorities.
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Umbrella migration goal including newly numbered happy-path/package obligations.

supplemental_clauses.text: Detect at least:
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Introduces the directly-numbered provider detection bullets.

supplemental_clauses.text: 1. inspect capabilities/state;
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Inspection is the aggregate of the position-9 detection promises.

supplemental_clauses.text: 2. validate/import `rclone.conf` into Nexus durable config;
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Positive migration config import was not previously numbered.

supplemental_clauses.text: 3. preserve encrypted config exactly;
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Exact preservation is distinct from the existing negative failure case RNX-P442.

supplemental_clauses.text: 4. discover existing provider-managed mounts/jobs;
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Already represented by provider mount/job detection promises.

supplemental_clauses.text: 5. offer import/review;
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Explicit review/selection before import was not previously numbered.

supplemental_clauses.text: 6. quiesce provider-owned lifecycle;
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Positive provider quiesce step was only indirectly covered by a negative stop-refusal case.

supplemental_clauses.text: 7. verify Nexus managed runtime/config;
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Migration-specific revalidation before authority switch was not independently numbered.

supplemental_clauses.text: 8. start only selected Nexus-defined mounts;
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Selection-bound mount activation was not independently numbered.

supplemental_clauses.text: 9. record migration evidence;
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Migration evidence persistence was not independently numbered.

supplemental_clauses.text: 10. report old module as no longer required, but do not silently uninstall it.
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Provider non-removal existed generally, but this migration completion/reporting obligation was not numbered.

supplemental_clauses.text: If parent `conf/sync` / `conf/copy` or equivalent exists, import into Nexus Jobs only after semantic validation. Disable competing provider scheduler before Nexus begins executing imported jobs.
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Contains two distinct migration obligations: semantic job import and scheduler handoff before execution.

supplemental_clauses.text: Normal installation should require only `rclone_nexus`. `install-stack` should become migration/legacy behavior rather than the default, subject to canonical-scope audit.
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Standalone-default packaging policy was not explicitly numbered.

supplemental_clauses.text: Cards/flows should expose:
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Introduces the directly-numbered Runtime Manager UI bullets.

supplemental_clauses.text:
ACTIVE ENGINE
bclone <latest resolved version>
BenjiThatFoxGuy/bclone
Android ARM64
✓ CLI
✓ FUSE
✓ Nexus qualified
[Change]
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Explicit example, not an additional promise beyond the surrounding Runtime Manager bullets.

supplemental_clauses.text: WebUI must call the same canonical runtime/update/migration authority used by `racctl`, not a parallel implementation.
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Broad runtime/source/update/migration parity is wider than the older activation-only authority promise.

supplemental_clauses.text: At minimum:
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Introduces the directly-numbered final real-device cases.

supplemental_clauses.text: At every point:
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Introduces the canonical single-lifecycle-authority invariant.

supplemental_clauses.text: number_of_active_lifecycle_authorities == 1
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Single runtime authority plus no dual mount/job authorities jointly represent this invariant.

supplemental_clauses.text: Only after standalone-runtime qualification succeeds:
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Orders the post-qualification final release sequence; child numbered steps are explicitly dispositioned below.

supplemental_clauses.text: 1. refresh original GRAND-G1 real-device evidence against final current HEAD;
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Fresh final-head evidence is covered by the original final-gate requirement plus current evidence binding/invalidation promises.

supplemental_clauses.text: 2. rerun adversarial gate audit loop;
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Authored-after-remediation and executed-negative-cases promises cover the repeated audit loop.

supplemental_clauses.text: 3. run authoritative `./devtoolw release` seal;
supplemental_clauses.rationale: The original final-gate promise requires the authoritative Devtool release workflow; P500 governs invalidation/rebuild.

supplemental_clauses.text: 4. ensure release evidence ancestry and hashes point to the final runtime architecture.
supplemental_clauses.rationale: Evidence resolution, source/runtime hashes and seal invalidation cover final ancestry binding.
